identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit 'Camp Phoenix', Oakland, CA, EIN 46-1470903 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer)
Camp Phoenix's job-board page says it partners with Oakland schools such as Greenleaf Elementary School, matching the OUSD contract titles for a Greenleaf Elementary summer learning program
Same page says Camp Phoenix was selected as an Oakland Unified Lead Summer Agency in 2015, matching OUSD's 'After-school & summer programs' contracts
research.notes: The agenda text gives the vendor location as Newark, CA, but Camp Phoenix is headquartered in Oakland (ProPublica, GuideStar: 10974 Star Ct, Oakland). A web search surfaced a Newark, CA address for a 'Camp Phoenix' that I could not verify; it may be an OUSD payment/remit address or a different entity, so confidence is medium rather than high. Greenleaf Elementary partnership and 2015 OUSD Lead Summer Agency selection come from Camp Phoenix's own job-board page. Address left null because only GuideStar (not cited) showed it.

profile.summary: Camp Phoenix is an Oakland-based nonprofit that runs a summer sleep-away camp and year-round weekend trips for middle school students from low-income families in the Bay Area. Its programs combine hands-on academics with outdoor activities and personal growth.
